mechanism: Torsemide may increase infection risk and reduce the efficacy of adalimumab by causing electrolyte depletion and volume depletion that impairs immune function; additionally, TNF-alpha inhibitors like adalimumab increase infection risk which is compounded by diuretic-induced immunosuppression.
action: Monitor electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly, maintain adequate hydration, educate patient on infection warning signs, and consider alternative diuretics if infection risk becomes prohibitive.
